_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - not real participant data. Format produced by CORAE build 0.15.0a, used in Study 2 (dyadic, online). One file per participant, downloaded by the participant as <participantID>results.json. Keys after 'ID' are timecodes 'H:M:S:frame' (video is 30 fps); values are the slider position as a string, integer in [-7, +7]. A sample is written every ~1 s AND whenever the slider moves, so spacing is irregular.
